test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If x - 1/x = 3, then the value of x² + 1/x² is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2

Given: k = 3

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 3² + 2 = 9 + 2 = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x − 1/x = 3

Formula Used: (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

⇒ Square both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 3²

⇒ x² + (1/x)² − 2 × x × (1/x) = 9

⇒ x² + 1/x² − 2 = 9

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 9 + 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Square Identity (Sum)

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Algebraic Cubic Identity (Difference)

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Relation between Squares of Sum and Difference

(x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4. This is used to find x + 1/x when x − 1/x is known.</p
